checks.message: Submitted geometry is explicitly provisional; official polygons remain a replacement gate before professional scoring or implementation.
All three required key areas are present and explicitly provisional; no parcel-level or statutory claim is made.
Six conceptual land-use polygons are partitioned from one projected parent polygon with shared cut edges, complete coverage, and no overlap.
Chinese and English visualization pages are offline-first and load only local submission assets.
The bilingual proposal cross-references standards, design-depth items, geometry, metrics, sources, assumptions, drawings, and human fallback conditions.
